_description: Vulnerability scan findings for Lab 9. Asset criticality and exposure come from the CMDB (config change_management.systems). 'as_of' is the triage date used for SLA / overdue / expiry checks.

findings.description: PHP-CGI argument injection lets an unauthenticated request run arbitrary commands on the web server.
Writing past the end of a fixed-size listener buffer crashes the process and can overwrite adjacent memory.
The ERP server runs an operating system the vendor no longer supports, so new flaws will never be patched.
A compromised upstream compression library release contains a backdoor that hooks SSH authentication.

exception.justification: Patching risks an auth outage during month-end.

findings.description: SMB signing is not required, so an on-path attacker can relay authentication to the share.
The developer portal reflects an unsanitised query parameter into the page, running attacker script in a victim's browser.
The app checks a file's permissions and then opens it later; the file can be swapped in between (time-of-check/time-of-use).
An unknown host found by the scanner still accepts TLS 1.0 with RC4 and export-grade ciphers.
Exploitation of the firewall's SSL-VPN portal is being seen in the wild and the vendor has not released a fix yet.
